subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer insisted he was done being the face of the party, tired of looking like a fool and nearly getting killed.
source_quote: Calmer, recovered from his brush with death, insisted they needed to change their approach. He declared he was done being the face of the party, tired of looking like a fool and nearly getting killed.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia’s concern for Calmer’s wellbeing was real, though Calmer claimed it was merely because reviving him was annoying.
source_quote: Zinnia’s concern for Calmer’s wellbeing—though he claimed it was merely because reviving him was annoying—brought a moment of levity to their tense situation.

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa noticed the gnolls seemed to be on patrol, possibly looking for the party themselves or dealing with the various bandit factions that plagued the region.
source_quote: Sequioa noticed the gnolls seemed to be on patrol, possibly looking for the party themselves or dealing with the various bandit factions that plagued the region.

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa’s keen hearing picked up the chief muttering complaints about recruiting gnolls from the local gnoll king for the fire temple.
source_quote: Sequioa’s keen hearing picked up the chief muttering complaints about recruiting gnolls from the local gnoll king for the fire temple.

subject: The Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil wasn’t just surviving, it was actively growing and recruiting forces.
source_quote: This revelation was troubling—the Temple of Elemental Evil wasn’t just surviving, it was actively growing and recruiting forces.

subject: The Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil had four cults led by prophets—Romag of Earth, Belsornig of Water, and two unnamed leaders of Fire and Air—all ruled by a mysterious deep temple.
source_quote: They also learned more about the temple’s structure: four cults led by prophets—Romag of Earth, Belsornig of Water, and two unnamed leaders of Fire and Air—all ruled by a mysterious deep temple.

subject: Skole
fact: Skole was visibly shocked to see the party alive.
source_quote: Skole, the bartender, was visibly shocked to see them alive.

subject: Skole
fact: Skole despised both Tolub and Lodriss, the tavern’s actual owner, and wished to be free of them both.
source_quote: Taking them into his back room, Skole confided that he despised both Tolub and Lodriss, the tavern’s actual owner, and wished to be free of them both.

subject: Skole
fact: Skole revealed that if the party wanted to contact the Earth Temple, they needed to speak with Dick Rentsch at the Waterside Hostel, not Tolub.
source_quote: More importantly, he told them that if they wanted to contact the Earth Temple, they needed to speak with Dick Rentsch at the Waterside Hostel, not Tolub, who worked for the fire prophet.

subject: The party
fact: The party saw a dead man hanging from the gallows—Elfar Twell, executed on the orders of the powerful Madame Selentis for the crime of crossing her.
source_quote: They encountered various merchant stalls, including Magda’s Trove with its strange magical curiosities like cursed ink, and Garik’s armory selling rusted weapons. These encounters painted a picture of Nulb as a desperate, dangerous place where power was everything. At the Waterside Hostel, a dilapidated building with sagging timbers and lopsided walls, they met Dick Rentsch.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch’s demeanor shifted to excitement when the party mentioned they had something of interest for the Earth Temple.
source_quote: When the party mentioned they had something of interest for the Earth Temple, Dick Rentsch’s demeanor shifted to excitement.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch warned the party he ran a tight operation that didn’t tolerate trouble.
source_quote: The gruff proprietor sized them up with suspicion and warned them he ran a tight operation that didn’t tolerate trouble.

subject: Wat
fact: Wat attempted to extract information about the party’s business, and when deflected, mentioned someone named Dala before warning them not to drink the beer and serving them gin instead.
source_quote: While waiting for Dick Rentsch to return that evening, the party was approached by Wat, the bartender, who attempted to extract information about their business. The party deflected his questions, claiming it was a personal matter. Wat seemed relieved and mentioned someone named Dala before warning them not to drink the beer and serving them gin instead.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch explained that to earn his trust and the prophet’s favor, the party needed to complete a mission: ambush and kill a group of gnolls and their handlers who were being recruited for the fire temple that very night.
source_quote: When Dick Rentsch finally returned, he explained that to earn his trust and the prophet’s favor, they needed to complete a mission: ambush and kill a group of gnolls and their handlers who were being recruited for the fire temple that very night.

subject: The bandit chief
fact: The bandit chief seemed paranoid, muttering that Dick Rentsch might be up to something.
source_quote: When the bandit chief appeared with his gnoll recruits, he seemed paranoid, muttering that Dick Rentsch might be up to something.

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa delivered a devastating strike that literally cut one gnoll in half.
source_quote: Sequioa delivered a devastating strike that literally cut one gnoll in half, while Zinnia moved with deadly precision through the chaos.

subject: Calmer

source_quote: Calmer created a terrifying booming voice that froze the gnolls in fear, while Zephyr methodically eliminated them one by one.

fact: The last bandit, realizing his leader was dead and contemplating his poor life choices, made a futile attack before being struck down.
